documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Board Meeting Intimation for Upcoming Board Meeting Of The Company.
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation

analysis.summary: RBZ Jewellers Limited reported a strong financial performance for Q1 FY27, with revenue from operations growing 60% year-on-year to INR 121 crores, driven by robust consumer demand and higher jewellery sales. EBITDA reached INR 18 crores with a margin of 14.9%, while Profit After Tax came in at INR 9 crores representing a 7.5% margin. The company is actively expanding its retail footprint with four new store launches planned in Gujarat across Surat, Rajkot, Gandhinagar, and Maninagar between Q2 and Q3 FY27. Management highlighted a long-term strategic shift towards scaling its retail operations and implementing gold hedging through Gold Metal Loans to optimize capital structure. RBZ Jewellers reported strong operational and financial performance for Q1 FY27, with operational revenue reaching INR 1,208 Mn and PAT at INR 91 Mn.

guidance.claim: The company targeted maximum utilisation of existing manufacturing capacity by FY26.
guidance.quote: Targeting maximum utilisation of existing manufacturing capacity by FY26

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the demand outlook for the second quarter is good and promising.
demand_outlook.quote: And the demand side looks to be good and promising for Quarter 2, as we are approaching.

demand_outlook.claim: The company expects a strong response from the B2B side as order book levels are robust.
demand_outlook.quote: The order book levels are also very strong for coming quarter also.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that IIJS received an encouraging response with buyer growth and good order backing.
demand_outlook.quote: It was encouraging and we have seen a buyer growth. We have seen a good order backing.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that revenue increased year-on-year driven by robust customer demand, higher jewellery sales, and strengthening brand recall.
demand_outlook.quote: Revenue increased by ~60% year-on-year, driven by robust customer demand, higher jewellery sales, and strengthening brand recall.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that consumer demand in the occasion wear segment remains steady ahead of the wedding season.
demand_outlook.quote: We continue to witness steady consumer demand in occasion wear segment ahead of the wedding season, while also optimizing our inventory mix with a greater focus on lightweight and budget-friendly product offering to cater to evolving consumer preference.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that April performance has been very good.
demand_outlook.quote: Now how has been April? April has been very good.

capex_expansion.claim: The Surat store is scheduled to launch in Quarter 2.
capex_expansion.quote: So, Surat will be launching in Quarter 2 and Rajkot in early Quarter 3.

capex_expansion.claim: Rajkot, Maninagar, and Gandhinagar stores are slated to open in Quarter 3.
capex_expansion.quote: And same, I think Maninagar and Gandhinagar both will be launched in Quarter 3 itself. So three stores in Quarter 3 and one store in Quarter 2, that is Surat.

capex_expansion.claim: Large format stores have a carpet area of around 10,000 square feet with inventory deployment between INR 125 crores and INR 150 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: The large format stores are typically around 10,000 square feet carpet area and mid format stores are 5,000 square feet carpet area. The inventory deployment in large format stores is typically around INR125 crores to INR150 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: Small format stores have inventory deployment around INR 50 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: While in small format stores are around INR50 crores, plus and minus 10%, 15%.

capex_expansion.claim: The capital expenditure incurred for the Surat store is approximately INR 10 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Approximately INR10 crores is the capex incurred for Surat store.

capex_expansion.claim: Retail expansion remains on track with flagship showrooms in Surat and Rajkot, alongside mid-sized stores in Maninagar and Gandhinagar.
capex_expansion.quote: Retail expansion remains on track, with flagship showrooms in Surat (by Q2) and Rajkot (by early Q3), alongside mid-sized stores in Maninagar (Ahmedabad East) and Gandhinagar, aimed at strengthening geographic presence and enhancing direct customer access across high-growth Gujarat markets.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is planning to expand its retail presence in Rajkot, Surat, and Ahmedabad.
capex_expansion.quote: We are also planning to expand our retail presence in Rajkot, Surat and Ahmedabad as well.

capex_expansion.claim: Both showrooms in Surat and Rajkot are targeted to commence operations by quarter 2 of FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: On the retail front, encouraged by the strong performance of our Ahmedabad store, we are now planning to expand in other key Gujarat markets, including Surat and Rajkot, both the showrooms are targeted to commence operations by quarter 2 of FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is actively exploring strategic locations in Eastern Ahmedabad and nearby cities such as Gandhinagar for mid-sized stores of around 5,000 square feet.
capex_expansion.quote: Further, we are actively exploring strategic location in Eastern Ahmedabad and nearby cities such as Gandhinagar for mid-sized stores of around 5,000 square feet and aimed at strengthening the regional presence and driving incremental growth.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for the quarter stood at INR 18 crores with a margin of 14.9%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the quarter is INR18 crores reflecting a healthy growth of 39% Y-o-Y, with EBITDA margins coming in a healthy 14.9%.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax for the quarter was INR 9 crores translating to a PAT margin of 7.5%.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax for the quarter has been 28% at INR9 crores translating PAT at 7.5%.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins for FY26 improved to 14.44% with an expansion of 233 basis points.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the year increased significantly by 43% to INR92 crores, with EBITDA margins improving to 14.44% and expansion of 233 basis points.

orders_capacity.claim: Total manufacturing capacity remains at around 1.8 to 2 tons per year.
orders_capacity.quote: The total capacity still remains at around 1.8 to 2 tons a year.

orders_capacity.claim: Factory capacity utilization is currently running at around 50%.
orders_capacity.quote: And the production that we are doing or the consumption that we are able to do is somewhere around 900 kgs to 1000 kgs. So, we are utilizing factory at around 50% of capacity.

orders_capacity.claim: During the quarter, the company launched 730 new designs averaging 8 designs per day primarily in the occasion wear segment.
orders_capacity.quote: During the quarter, we launched 730 new designs averaging 8 designs per day, primarily in occasion wear segment further strengthening our product portfolio

orders_capacity.claim: The current capacity utilization is approximately 50% or 55%.
orders_capacity.quote: The capacity utilization is approximately 50% or 55%.

capital_allocation.claim: The company has a sanctioned debt of around INR 300 crores which is sufficient for the four stores launching this financial year.
capital_allocation.quote: Given that we have a sanctioned debt of around INR300 crores. And we are yet to utilize it, which is sufficient for the four stores that is coming in this financial year.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that the average gold rate remained stagnant, resulting in negligible inventory gain during the quarter.
risks_headwinds.quote: One is that the average gold rate has remained stagnant and thus there is negligible inventory gain in the system as of now.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that recent customs duty and advanced authorization events are very immediate and they are taking time to understand how the market and consumers are reacting.
risks_headwinds.quote: So see, these are very immediate events or it has just been a few days that these all things are happening. And generally, we would take some time, let's say, a week or 2, in fact, a little bit more to understand what -- how the market and the consumers are reacting.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the B2B to B2C revenue mix is expected to reach 50-50 in a year or two.
management_commitments.quote: the mix has to, I think the B2B to B2C mix has to be 50-50 or so in a year or two

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that in the long term, the revenue mix will be 75-25 with retail contributing 75%.
management_commitments.quote: and in long term it will be 75-25, 75 being retail.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets achieving capital expenditure break-even for the new stores in a year or less.
management_commitments.quote: the capex break-even will be achieved in a year or less.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects to keep the debt-to-equity ratio below 1:1 by the end of this financial year.
management_commitments.quote: By the end of this financial year, we will be still below 1:1 ratio. I guess 0.8 will be debt and 1 equity.

management_commitments.claim: Management anticipates that 18-carat share in corporate sales will reach at least 20% by the end of the year.
management_commitments.quote: I see by the end of this year, it will be at least 20% will be of 18 caratage.

management_commitments.claim: Management targeted maximum utilisation of existing manufacturing capacity by FY26.
management_commitments.quote: Targeting maximum utilisation of existing manufacturing capacity by FY26

management_commitments.claim: Both showrooms in Surat and Rajkot are targeted to commence operations by quarter 2 of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: On the retail front, encouraged by the strong performance of our Ahmedabad store, we are now planning to expand in other key Gujarat markets, including Surat and Rajkot, both the showrooms are targeted to commence operations by quarter 2 of FY27.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
